items.name: Please Be Quiet Bergen 2023
items.information:
**Norsk:**
Denne konkurransen tar utgangspunkt i blindegrener. Konkurransen vil **IKKE** holde 3x3, for de som ønsker å delta i 3x3 kan vi anbefale å sjekke ut [Bergen Fall 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenFall2023).

**Engelsk:**
This competition mainly holds blindfolded events. The competition will **NOT** hold 3x3, for those who wish to participate in 3x3 we would like to recommend [Bergen Fall 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BergenFall2023).

items.name: CubingUSA New England Championship 2023
items.information:
We are pleased to announce the first CubingUSA New England Championship!

This competition is open to all competitors, but only competitors who are residents of Massachusetts, Connecticut, Rhode Island, Vermont, New Hampshire, and Maine are eligible to win the title of New England Champion.

items.name: Colorado Pastacomp 2023
items.information:
The space for this competition is provided by the Hilton Garden Inn and Johnny's Italian Steakhouse - lunch from the steakhouse will be provided to all competitors and one guest each (hence the larger registration fees). More details on this will be provided closer to the competition, but it should include pasta, barbeque, potatoes, etc. **Please comment the name of your guest when you register. This is not final and can be changed.**

* It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot.
* Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) will provide you with most of the information you need.
* If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 8:15 AM.
